clauses.clause: Scry 3, then reveal the top card of your library.
clauses.evidence: [cast] and [cast | ask N -> bottom]: three 'ask scry: [top, bottom]' asks, one per card of the top three; a card sent to the bottom changes which card is drawn afterwards ([ask 1 -> bottom] draws Library 4#1, the next card). Tree equals the compiler's parse (B5b-scr-reveal). Sorcery, cost G-1 plus 1 generic.
clauses.issue: engine-limit: SCRY never asks the order of the cards kept on top (or bottom). verbs.py:1086-1094 pins Handle-ascending order instead of 'the rest on top in any order'. Every result is one the player could have chosen, so it is only weaker.

clauses.clause: If it's a creature or land card, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: Trace: every probe library card is a creature, so the revealed card always qualifies and one card is drawn (the revealed top card). Not exercised there: the non-qualifying and land cases. Packs: track_down_reveals_noncreature_no_draw (an instant is revealed: no draw, it stays on top) PASS; track_down_reveals_land_draws (a Forest is revealed and drawn) PASS. They kill an always-draw mutant and a creature-only mutant. Tree equals the compiler's parse (B5b-if-it-type-then).
